GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (7 Sep 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1187)
APO 500
7 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 6 November 1945, file AG 000.5 (6 Nov 45) LS, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one CHISUWA, Buichi, 1st Lieutenant, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugatno prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said CHISUWA's name. This name appears as the first in Sub-Branch #1, Sendai Area, page No. 3 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. GOOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
